audit.why: Renekton favoured 1-5, level 6 skill (Glacial Prison), Sejuani takes over at two items. Both layers already agree row for row; win rate 50.48% over 313 games supports the near-even overall read at 4/10 difficulty.
audit.corrected: No side flips. whys[0] reworded so the prose stops calling Level 1 'neutral' while both layers award it to Renekton.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike described Glacial Prison as 'a point-and-click AoE stun'. It is a 1300-range bola projectile that stuns the first champion hit.
audit.why: Point-and-click means you cannot play around it; a first-hit projectile means you can bait it, body-block it, or sidestep it — which changes whether you commit Dominus at all.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now names Glacial Prison, its 1300 range, first-champion-hit behaviour and 120s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two structural errors. (1) The page is built around 'track Permafrost's cooldown' — Permafrost (E) has a 1.5s cooldown, so it has no meaningful cooldown; the real gate is Frost stacks, which Winter's Wrath (W, 9/8/7/6/5s) applies. (2) Three places claim Sejuani 'has no dash' / 'no escape'. Arctic Assault (Q) is a 650-range charge that knocks up and stops on the first champion hit, 18s at rank 1.
audit.why: Both errors point the player at the wrong timer and hide her only mobility and her only knockup, which can interrupt Slice and Dice mid-commit.
audit.corrected: Permafrost reframed as a stack gate, not a cooldown; Arctic Assault named with its 18s cooldown and knockup wherever the text asserted she had no dash.
sources: champ-data/_kits/sejuani.json (E cd 1.5, W cd 9/8/7/6/5, Q cd 18/16.5/15/13.5/12 range 650)

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns told the player to track a 1.5s ability before every engage.
audit.why: The punishable cooldowns here are Arctic Assault (18s) and Glacial Prison (120s), plus your own Slice and Dice at 16s rank 1.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with real numbers on both sides.

edits.before: Level 1 is neutral — Sejuani's W percent-HP damage starts immediately but her early burst is low, so farm safely with Q range and build fury rather than trading even.
edits.after: Your fury autos out-trade her at 1 — Winter's Wrath is her only spell, 60 mana on a 9s cooldown, so build fury on the wave and take the short exchanges she cannot repeat.

edits.before: Sejuani has no escape and her Permafrost cooldown is long enough that you can force repeated burst trades — sustain the lead with Q healing and deny her farm under the threat of another all-in.
edits.after: Arctic Assault (Q) is her only mobility and it is down 18s at rank 1 — force your burst trades inside that window, sustain with Q healing, and deny her farm under the threat of an all-in she cannot charge out of.

edits.before: Dominus stats are big but her R hard-CC is the equalizer — bait the R before committing your full Dominus all-in or the stun just hands the kill back to her.
edits.after: Dominus stats are big but Glacial Prison equalizes — the bola stops on the first champion it hits, so bait or sidestep it before you commit, or the stun hands the kill back.

edits.before: Your E-W stun into Q heal combo comes fully online — Sejuani has no dash to escape and her Permafrost passive requires multiple hits to proc, so she cannot punish your burst window if you dash out immediately after Q.
edits.after: Your E-W stun into Q heal comes fully online — Permafrost (E) only fires at max Frost stacks, so burst her before Winter's Wrath stacks them. Her one answer is Arctic Assault (Q), an 18s charge that knocks you up: bait it first.

edits.before: Sejuani's R becomes the great equalizer — a point-and-click AoE stun that can flip any all-in you start, so Dominus stats alone no longer guarantee the kill.
edits.after: Glacial Prison is the equalizer — a 1300-range bola that stuns the first champion it hits, so it is dodgeable. Bait it, then commit Dominus on its 120s downtime.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you are still favoured but the margin is shrinking: Sejuani's W percent-HP damage accumulates fast in drawn-out trades, so keep enforcing the burst pattern and never let her stack Permafrost with repeated autos while you are tanking her aura. Level 6 is the swing point — your Dominus gives you a massive HP buffer and fury for back-to-back empowered Ws, but her R is a point-and-click stun that she can throw the moment you commit. Do not auto-pilot an all-in at 6; bait the R first by faking the engage, then punish the whiff with Dominus active.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you are still favoured but the margin is shrinking: Sejuani's W percent-HP damage accumulates fast in drawn-out trades, so keep enforcing the burst pattern and never let her stack Frost with repeated autos while you are tanking her aura. Level 6 is the swing point — your Dominus gives you a massive HP buffer and fury for back-to-back empowered Ws, but Glacial Prison is a 1300-range bola that stuns the first champion it hits, and at melee range it will not miss. Fake the engage to draw it, then punish the 120s whiff with Dominus active.

edits.before: - Sejuani Permafrost: matchup-defining — Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sejuani Permafrost: 1.5s cooldown, so it is not a timer — Frost stacks are, and Winter's Wrath stacks them every 9s. - Arctic Assault: her only mobility, 18s at rank 1 — that is the window. - Slice and Dice: 16s at rank 1, never on chip. - Dominus: 120s.

edits.before: Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Permafrost fires off Frost stacks, not a cooldown — leave the trade before Winter's Wrath tops you out.

edits.before: Track Sejuani's Permafrost: Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. When it is down — Fury W-stun + dash out.
edits.after: Permafrost stuns only at max Frost stacks, and Winter's Wrath builds them on a 9s cooldown — burst inside that window, then dash out.

edits.before: Survive lane and reach her teamfight power spike where her R hard-CC controls every fight
edits.after: Catch you with Arctic Assault's knockup, stack Frost, and reach the teamfight spike where Glacial Prison controls every fight

notes: Mirror sejuani__renekton already audited; its findings (Slice and Dice as the dash, 50-Fury thresholds, Frost Armor named correctly) are consistent with this side and no side or rating was flipped, so the two pages still agree. The dominant error on this page was treating Permafrost as a cooldown to track — it is 1.5s. Renekton's empowered W destroys damage shields, which does nothing here: Frost Armor is resistances, not a shield, so no claim was made about it.
